videos.headline: Jordan Hawkins leads UConn past Nova with 22-point game
videos.description: Jordan Hawkins scores a team-high 22 points to help No. 2 UConn improve to 14-0 with a win over Villanova.

videos.headline: UConn's Jordan Hawkins buries 3 despite being fouled
videos.description: Jordan Hawkins earns a four-point play for UConn with a 3-pointer plus the foul.

videos.headline: Andre Jackson left all alone for a UConn slam
videos.description: Adama Sanogo is double-teamed in the post and dishes to Andre Jackson for an easy dunk.

videos.headline: Jackson skies for rebound and dishes to Clingan for 2
videos.description: UConn's Andre Jackson rises high for an offensive rebound and then sends a pass to Donovan Clingan for a basket down low.

videos.headline: Caleb Daniels muscles in and-1 for Villanova
videos.description: Caleb Daniels backs down Jordan Hawkins in the post and finishes strong for the hoop and the harm.

videos.headline: Andre Jackson splashes timely 3 for UConn
videos.description: Andre Jackson gives UConn a seven-point lead with a corner 3-pointer in the final minutes.
